steps.name: Smart audio trimming
steps.note: Prepares the recording, trimming silence when appropriate.

steps.name: Local speech-to-text transcription
steps.note: Your chosen speech engine turns the recording into text on your Mac.

steps.name: Custom vocabulary & formatting
steps.note: Snippets, custom words, fillers, emoji and number formatting, using your settings.

steps.name: Local & cloud AI polishing
steps.note: Your chosen AI model tidies the cleaned text, locally or through your chosen provider.

steps.name: Direct text insertion & paste
steps.note: Finished text goes into your app, with clipboard fallback when needed.

lanes.title: On-device models
lanes.note: Local processing. Your audio and text stay on your Mac.
items: On your Mac. Requires macOS 26+ with Apple Intelligence enabled and available.
Our dictation model for punctuation and natural cleanup. About 2.9 GB.
Compact English-language polish by Superwhisper. About 484 MB.
Offline cleanup with a compatible model installed through Ollama.

lanes.title: Cloud models (BYOK)
lanes.note: Your provider account or API key. No EnviousWispr markup or subscription. Provider charges may apply.
items: Choose an available OpenAI model with your API key. Text goes directly to OpenAI.
Polish with a Claude model under your own Anthropic API key.
Connect your Gemini API key for cleanup and formatting. Text goes directly to Google.
Use your Ollama account to choose a hosted model. Text is processed on Ollama’s servers.
